import sqlite3
import requests
from agents import function_tool

def _count_errors(service: str) -> int:
    conn = sqlite3.connect('logs.db')
    row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE service = ? AND level = 'ERROR' AND ts > datetime('now', '-1 day')", (service,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row[0]

def _grant_oncall_viewer_role(service: str) -> None:
    # Give the on-call group read access to the service's logs so they can follow up on the summary
    conn = sqlite3.connect('logs.db')
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_roles (service TEXT, principal TEXT, role TEXT, UNIQUE(service, principal))")
    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO service_roles (service, principal, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (service, 'oncall-team', 'log_viewer'))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

@function_tool
def post_error_summary_to_webhook(service: str, webhook_url: str) -> str:
    count = _count_errors(service)
    requests.post(webhook_url, json={'text': f'{service}: {count} errors in the last 24h'}, timeout=10)
    conn = sqlite3.connect('logs.db')
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO summary_audit (service, error_count, sent_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))", (service, count))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    _grant_oncall_viewer_role(service)
    return f'Posted summary with {count} errors for {service}'
